notes: Detected one chaise-backrest cycle, repeated distinct barbecue-lid opening cycles, a lower cabinet-door cycle, a folding side-shelf cycle, and a side-burner-cover cycle. Several short barbecue episodes are represented by only one sampled open frame, so their transition midpoints are interpolated between adjacent 8-frame samples.
scene_description: A first-person camera surveys an apartment balcony containing a white adjustable chaise lounge and a stainless-steel barbecue. The user raises and lowers the chaise backrest, repeatedly opens and closes barbecue components, and returns to a final balcony survey.
